name: chem
title: Chemistry and materials
summary: Quantum chemistry (PySCF, Psi4, xtb), plane-wave DFT (Quantum ESPRESSO), molecular dynamics (GROMACS, OpenMM), and structure tools for molecules and crystals (ASE, pymatgen, spglib, phonopy, Open Babel). No pseudopotential or force-field libraries beyond what the programs ship. For analysis and simulation; synthesis-route planners are left out on purpose.

tools.name: pyscf
tools.does: quantum chemistry in Python: Hartree-Fock, DFT, coupled cluster, for molecules and periodic systems
tools.usage: python: from pyscf import gto, scf, dft
tools.check: python -c "from pyscf import gto, scf; m=gto.M(atom='H 0 0 0; H 0 0 0.74', basis='sto-3g', verbose=0); print('E', round(scf.RHF(m).kernel(),3))"

tools.name: xtb
tools.does: fast semi-empirical quantum chemistry (GFN-xTB): energies, geometry optimisation, large molecules
tools.check:
printf '3

O 0 0 0
H 0 0.757 0.587
H 0 -0.757 0.587
' > w.xyz; xtb w.xyz 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'TOTAL ENERGY'

tools.name: psi4
tools.does: quantum chemistry program: SCF, DFT, MP2, coupled cluster, SAPT
tools.check:
printf 'molecule {
H
H 1 0.74
}
set basis sto-3g
e = energy("scf")
print_out("HIVE %%.3f" %% e)
' > h2.dat; psi4 -i h2.dat -o h2.out; grep HIVE h2.out

tools.name: quantum espresso
tools.does: plane-wave density-functional theory for solids (pw.x and friends). You supply the pseudopotential files

tools.name: gromacs
tools.does: molecular dynamics for biomolecules and soft matter

tools.name: openmm
tools.does: molecular dynamics from Python, with the common biomolecular force fields; uses the GPU when a run is allowed one

tools.name: ase
tools.does: atomic simulation environment: build molecules, surfaces and crystals, run and analyse calculations
tools.usage: python: from ase.build import molecule, bulk
tools.check: python -c "from ase.build import molecule; print('atoms', len(molecule('H2O')))"

tools.name: pymatgen, spglib, phonopy
tools.does: crystal structures, symmetry and space groups, phase diagrams (pymatgen, spglib); phonons (phonopy)
tools.usage: python: from pymatgen.core import Structure, Lattice; import spglib, phonopy
tools.check: python -c "from pymatgen.core import Lattice, Structure; import phonopy, spglib; s=Structure(Lattice.cubic(4.2), ['Cs','Cl'], [[0,0,0],[.5,.5,.5]]); print('sg', s.get_space_group_info()[1])"

tools.name: open babel, mdanalysis
tools.does: converts between chemical file formats (obabel); analysis of molecular-dynamics trajectories (MDAnalysis)
tools.usage: obabel in.sdf -O out.xyz   |   python: import MDAnalysis
